recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source change is needed for FHIR-37482; separately tracked later actor-reference issues should remain governed by their own Jira decisions and reconciliation records.
issue_request: FHIR-37482 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-I request to create an ActorDefinition resource at FMM0 so implementation guides, ExampleScenario, and PlanDefinition could share canonical actor definitions instead of relying on separate local actor structures.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-37482 was found. Git commit 63a82280f55755231a27b237a469fcaf16485af7, 'Add ActorDefinition and Requirements', added the source/actordefinition resource source files, examples, search parameters, and active source/fhir.ini entries; that commit is contained in the v5.0.0 tag.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2022-05-23 confirm the 11-0-1 endorsement motion for ActorDefinition. The linked Zulip must-support discussion shows the actor work came from actor-specific implementation obligation modeling. FHIR-37473 was rejected as a duplicate of this seed, and later applied issues such as FHIR-41225, FHIR-42807, and FHIR-42717 refined ExampleScenario and PlanDefinition references.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source has an active actordefinition resource entry in source/fhir.ini, an ActorDefinition StructureDefinition and supporting source files under source/actordefinition, and current canonical ActorDefinition references from ExampleScenario, PlanDefinition, Requirements, and CapabilityStatement.

related_jiras.note: Rejected as a duplicate because FHIR-37482 already provided the standard ActorDefinition resource path.
